page_title: ATM 1-1 RMA | Atletico Madrid v Real Madrid 29/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+9' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.
90+8' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid)! Let's see what he decides.
90+8' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.

90+6' 1 - 1 Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Atl. Madrid players have a reason to celebrate! Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and sends in a superb strike that finds its way into the bottom left corner.
90+6' Wait! Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90+5' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
90+4' Atl. Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+3' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom right corner is far too weak and Thibaut Courtois makes a simple save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

90+1' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' It is time for a substitution. Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) is on for Rodrygo.
90' Atl. Madrid win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
90' Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer sees the trip by Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.

89' Endrick (Real Madrid) creates some space for himself and unleashes a strike from long range, but his effort sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
89' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball has crossed the sideline. Atl. Madrid are taking a throw-in.
87' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Vinicius Junior and he is replaced by Endrick (Real Madrid).
87' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Rodrigo Riquelme. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
86' We are about to witness a subsitution. Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) for Luka Modric.
86' The linesman signals that Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

86' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
83' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
83' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

82' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Thibaut Courtois makes a great save to deny his effort directed to the top left corner. Atl. Madrid earn a corner.

81' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
79' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort well wide of the left post.
77' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
76' The ball is cleared after Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Real Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
75' Substitution. Reinildo Mandava leaves the pitch and is replaced by Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid).
75' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Julian Alvarez will be replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).
75' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer had an easy-decision to make.
74' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

73' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom right corner, but Jan Oblak made an astonishing save! The referee signals a corner kick to Real Madrid.
71' Conor Gallagher goes off the pitch and Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
70' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid).
69' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
69' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
67' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
64' 0 - 1 Goal! Eder Militao (Real Madrid) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Jan Oblak. He makes it 0:1.
63' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) is able to continue to play.
63' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
63' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
61' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
58' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
57' Antoine Griezmann loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid).
56' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) comes onto the pitch so that Alexander Sorloth can be given a rest.
55' The corner is swung in but Atl. Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
54' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Atl. Madrid win a corner.

51' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
51' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) works the corner short.

51' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Real Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
49' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
49' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
47' Koke (Atl. Madrid) plays another first-time pass to Julian Alvarez and the two of them continue to link up brilliantly.
46' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
46' Diego Simeone makes a half-time substitution. Koke comes on in place of Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header directed towards the goal is brilliantly saved by the goalkeeper.
45+1' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
45' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
45' One of the Real Madrid players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
43' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
40' Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows a yellow card to Luka Modric (Real Madrid) for his blatant foul.
40' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) displays his superb passing ability after picking out Jude Bellingham with a fine lofted pass to continue their attacking move.
38' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.

36' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Jan Oblak pulls off an easy save.
35' The Real Madrid players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
33' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) and Luka Modric attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
29' Foul! Eder Militao (Real Madrid) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
28' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) plays a one-two with Vinicius Junior, but the move breaks down. The ball is out of play. Real Madrid will have a throw-in.

28' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) knew what to do with the ball, but was just a bit unlucky. After receiving a pass, he sent the ball goalwards from some 35 metres out, but he missed the right post by a whisker.
26' Mateo Busquets Ferrer interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid). Real Madrid have a free kick.
25' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
23' Atl. Madrid are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
22' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
20' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
18' Real Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

17' A neat pass finds Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the left side of the goal, but Jan Oblak denies him with a good save. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
16' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sprays a pass out to Alexander Sorloth, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
16' A pass by Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is out of play. Real Madrid will take a throw-in.
15' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) jumps into a tackle and Mateo Busquets Ferrer signals a foul.
13' A cross from a corner kick by Real Madrid is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
12' Luka Modric receives a sweet cross inside the box from Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball. Real Madrid have a corner.
10' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
8' Atl. Madrid hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
7' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) tries to find Alexander Sorloth, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
4' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul. Real Madrid get a free kick.
3' Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.

1' A cross by Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Real Madrid will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Mateo Busquets Ferrer.
